title: Decorative shrouds.
officialText:
Decorative shrouds shall not be installed at the termination of factory-built chimneys except where such
shrouds are listed and labeled for use with the specific factory-built chimney system and are installed in accordance with Section
304.1.
SECTION MC 806
METAL CHIMNEYS
